title: Hardening host OS-a, identiteti i mrežni pristup
summary: Smanjenje površine napada na čvorovima: nepotrebni servisi, paketi i portovi, least privilege za korisnike, sudo, SSH i cloud IAM, te host firewall i security grupe sa samo potrebnim Kubernetes portovima.
title_en: Host OS hardening, identities and network access
summary_en: Reducing the attack surface of nodes: unneeded services, packages and ports, least privilege for users, sudo, SSH and cloud IAM, plus host firewalls and security groups that allow only the required Kubernetes ports.
